subject.title: fix(diagnostics-otel): normalize shared signal OTLP endpoints

question: Which single current-base implementation should own the diagnostics-otel shared signal-qualified endpoint fix: this focused PR after rebase, or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101655?
rationale: Both open PRs target the same compatibility-sensitive routing change, but this branch is merge-conflicting and the supplied evidence does not establish which candidate best matches current main.

options.title: Rebase and retain this focused PR
options.body: Resolve the current-base conflict, verify the shared-versus-explicit endpoint contract on the rebased head, and land this three-file implementation.

options.title: Adopt the later overlapping PR
options.body: Close this candidate only after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101655 is confirmed current-base clean and remains the narrower safe landing path.

options.title: Defer the behavior change
options.body: Keep existing shared-endpoint behavior if maintainers intentionally support routing all signals to one exact collector URL.
